infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RapidReps uses your location to show nearby trainers and estimate their arrival time for your workouts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RapidReps keeps tracking your location while a session is en-route so your trainer (or trainee) can see your live arrival progress, even when the app is backgrounded.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: RapidReps keeps tracking your location while a session is en-route so the other party can see your live arrival progress.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RapidReps uses the camera for profile photos, verification, and uploading session media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RapidReps lets you upload photos and videos for profiles and session content.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Share your training session status with emergency contacts for safety.
